verdict.rationale: AWS ships an official, first-party CLI (AWS CLI v2) that controls multiple AWS services from the terminal and can be automated through scripts. It matches console functionality and adds command completion, auto-prompting, command history and an 'aws login' credential flow. A probe confirms the official CLI install docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and evidence of agent-oriented features such as structured machine-readable output for AI workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: With just one tool to download and configure, you can control multiple AWS services from the command line and automate them through scripts.
the AWS CLI enables you to start running commands that implement functionality equivalent to that provided by the browser-based AWS Management Console from the command prompt in your terminal program
The AWS CLI v2 can prompt you with commands, parameters, resources, documentation, and more when running an 'aws' command.
